title: Bounding Switching Costs in Plan Choice Panels with Menu Entry and Exit
banked_reason: The note proves a sharp finite-response conditional-iid representation, eventual stabilization after finitely many price breakpoints, the finite-ceiling iff criterion, and certified approximation and inference, but it does not deliver the stipulated non-generic three-plan analytic body.
gap_reasons: The proposal's mandatory latent-free complete analytic body for every three-plan entry/exit class is still explicitly open (including negative/zero entry and all exit classes), so the focal usable three-plan deliverable and its attaining mixtures are absent.

The exact negative-entry cone has eight coupled quadratic curve families sharing four square-coordinate budgets. With both off-diagonal coordinates positive, its dual support function contains a switching term involving their minimum, so separately optimized face inequalities give only an outer description.

Novelty against the closest Pakes et al. comparison remains conditional on an inaccessible April-2026 revision; retrieve and compare that published/revised theorem text before retaining the no-prior-frontier positioning.
proof_attempt_summary: The run established the finite conditional-iid response-table representation, finite price-breakpoint stabilization, a sharp finite-ceiling criterion, and certified approximation/inference. It enumerated all nine terminal three-plan classes and reduced the negative and zero-sign entry problems to eight and seven quadratic curve families, but the coupled negative-entry interior resisted a complete latent-free elimination; zero-sign entry and all six exit classes likewise lack full Boolean inequalities and constructive attaining mixtures. A future re-raise should begin with the full negative-entry interior generator theorem, then complete the remaining classes and the April-2026 Pakes comparison.
tldr: Plan persistence confounds switching costs with stable consumer-by-plan tastes, while existing nonparametric health-choice bounds discard year pairs with plan entry or exit. For one known design cell, the project maps menu turnover into strict utility-comparison graphs and an exact convex-hull representation of compatible path probabilities. It proves that the compatible body stabilizes after finitely many rational price breakpoints and that positive distance from the terminal body is exactly the finite switching-cost-ceiling criterion for the maintained absolutely continuous conditional-iid class. Observable-moment compression yields a certified finite-menu approximation whose error depends on the observed path dimension, and simultaneous multinomial inversion gives whole-set coverage while preserving an admissible infinite ceiling. A complete latent-free three-plan entry-and-exit characterization is not claimed and remains \(\texttt{oeq:three-plan-analytic-body}\).
gap: Pakes et al. Condition 2.2 and Theorem 2.3(a), PDF p. 20 of the canonical revised-July-2025 manuscript, require the two comparator subsets to coincide in a common choice universe and deliver the resulting joint probability inequality. Entry or exit changes the feasible winner--loser comparisons and prevents that common-universe samplewise containment from covering the full observed menus. Mbakop's conditional-iid geometry shows that adding more linear inequalities cannot generally recover sharpness. No inspected paper gives an exact upper-tail saturation theorem, an observable finite-ceiling criterion, or a complete analytic three-plan turnover body.
fill: The project derives the finite terminal graph, exact compatible bodies, the iff finite-ceiling frontier, displayed three-plan Boolean formulas with attaining mixtures, and a certified approximation-and-inference layer for arbitrary finite menus.
